# my work in progress
def solve_toggle_ring(lights):
    from collections import deque
    # [True, True, True, False]
    n = len(lights)
    queue = deque()
    visited_set = set()
    
    queue.append((lights.copy(), []))
    
    while queue:
        state, moves = queue.popleft()

        # Goal check: all lights are off
        if not any(state):
            return moves

        # Try pressing each index i from 0 to n-1
        for i in range(n):
            next_state = state.copy()
            
            # Toggle i-1, i, and i+1 with modulo wrapping
            next_state[(i - 1) % n] = not next_state[(i - 1) % n]
            next_state[i] = not next_state[i]
            next_state[(i + 1) % n] = not next_state[(i + 1) % n]

            state_tuple = tuple(next_state)
            if state_tuple not in visited_set:
                visited_set.add(state_tuple)
                queue.append((next_state, moves + [i]))

    return None
